compassionate leave: After his father passed away, the company gave him a week of compassionate leave to attend the funeral.
他父親過世後，公司給了他一週的恩恤假去參加葬禮。
a compassionate response: When I told her my dog had died, she gave me a compassionate response and a warm hug.
當我告訴她我的狗死了，她給了我一個充滿同情的回應和溫暖的擁抱。
be compatible with: This new game is not compatible with my old computer, so I cannot install or play it.
這款新遊戲與我的舊電腦不相容，所以我無法安裝也不能玩。
a compatible partner: They share the same hobbies and values, so she has found a very compatible partner for life.
他們有相同的嗜好和價值觀，所以她找到了一位非常合得來的終身伴侶。
compatible software: Before buying the printer, make sure it comes with compatible software that works on your computer system.
買印表機之前，要確定它附有能在你的電腦系統上運作的相容軟體。
be competent to judge: I am only a beginner, so I am not competent to judge this painting; you should ask an expert.
我只是個初學者，所以沒有資格評斷這幅畫；你應該去問專家。
a competent teacher: A competent teacher knows the subject well and can explain difficult ideas clearly to every student.
一位稱職的老師對學科非常熟悉，能把困難的概念清楚地解釋給每個學生聽。
perfectly competent: My sister is perfectly competent to run the shop alone, so you don't need to worry while we are away.
我妹妹完全勝任獨自經營這家店，所以我們不在時你不必擔心。
a competitive price: This store sells laptops at a competitive price, much cheaper than most other shops in the area.
這家店以有競爭力的價格販售筆電，比這一帶大多數店家都便宜許多。
a highly competitive market: The smartphone business is a highly competitive market, where many companies fight hard for customers.
智慧型手機產業是個競爭激烈的市場，許多公司都在拚命爭取顧客。
a competitive spirit: Jason has a competitive spirit; he always wants to win, even in a simple card game with his family.
傑森很有好勝心；他總是想贏，連跟家人玩簡單的紙牌遊戲也一樣。
a competitive edge: Speaking three languages gives her a competitive edge over other people applying for the same job.
會說三種語言讓她比其他應徵同一份工作的人更具競爭優勢。
a competitive salary: To attract talented engineers, the company offers a competitive salary that is higher than its rivals pay.
為了吸引優秀的工程師，這家公司提供比競爭對手更高、有競爭力的薪資。
component parts: The mechanic took the engine apart and carefully checked all its component parts, one by one.
技師把引擎拆開，一個一個仔細檢查所有的組成部件。
a key component of: Regular exercise is a key component of a healthy lifestyle, along with good food and enough sleep.
規律運動是健康生活方式的關鍵要素，此外還有良好的飲食和充足的睡眠。
a compound word: 'Sunflower' is a compound word because it is made by joining the two words 'sun' and 'flower.'
「Sunflower」是一個複合詞，因為它是由「sun」和「flower」兩個字組合而成的。
compound interest: Thanks to compound interest, the money in your bank account grows faster because you earn interest on interest.
多虧了複利，你銀行帳戶裡的錢會成長得更快，因為利息也會再生利息。
a compound sentence: 'I was tired, but I finished my homework' is a compound sentence joined by the word 'but.'
「我很累，但我寫完了功課」是一個用「but」連接的複合句。
a compound fracture: He fell off his bike and suffered a compound fracture, with the broken bone sticking out through his skin.
他從腳踏車上摔下來，造成開放性骨折，斷掉的骨頭刺穿了皮膚。
compulsory education: In Taiwan, compulsory education now lasts twelve years, so all children must attend school until about eighteen.
在台灣，義務教育現在為十二年，所以所有孩子都必須上學到大約十八歲。
compulsory military service: In some countries, young men must do compulsory military service for one or two years after high school.
在某些國家，年輕男性高中畢業後必須服一到兩年的義務兵役。
It is compulsory to wear a helmet: It is compulsory to wear a helmet when riding a scooter in Taiwan, and you will be fined if you don't.
在台灣騎機車時戴安全帽是強制規定，不戴的話會被罰款。
concrete evidence: The police believed he stole the money, but they had no concrete evidence, such as fingerprints or videos.
警方相信是他偷了錢，但他們沒有具體證據，例如指紋或影片。
take concrete steps: Instead of making vague promises, the mayor should take concrete steps, like adding more bus lines downtown.
市長不應只做模糊的承諾，而應採取具體措施，例如在市區增加更多公車路線。
a concrete proposal: Instead of general ideas, she brought a concrete proposal with a clear budget, a timeline, and a list of tasks.
她帶來的不是籠統的想法，而是一份附有明確預算、時程和工作清單的具體提案。
concrete nouns: Words like 'table' and 'apple' are concrete nouns, because you can see and touch the things they name.
像「table」和「apple」這樣的字是具體名詞，因為它們指的東西你看得到也摸得到。
a concrete jungle: After living for years in a concrete jungle of tall buildings and few trees, she moved to the countryside.
在高樓林立、樹木稀少的水泥叢林裡住了多年後，她搬到了鄉下。
confidential information: Doctors must keep patients' records as confidential information and never share them with anyone without permission.
醫生必須將病人的病歷視為機密資訊，未經允許絕不與任何人分享。
strictly confidential: The details of the new product are strictly confidential, so please do not tell anyone outside the company.
新產品的細節是絕對保密的，所以請不要告訴公司以外的任何人。
a confidential report: The manager wrote a confidential report about the accident, which only the company's top leaders were allowed to read.
經理寫了一份關於這起事故的機密報告，只有公司高層才獲准閱讀。
a confidential tone: She lowered her voice and spoke in a confidential tone, as if she were sharing a secret only with me.
她壓低聲音，用推心置腹的語氣說話，彷彿只和我分享一個祕密。
